headline: Geely's founder is stepping down from the automaker's leadership. He started with refrigerators and a fake Mercedes
summary: Geely founder Li Shufu is stepping down from the leadership of the automaker this year. Geely is now one of China's largest carmakers and has reached the global top ten by volume.
why: Geely Automobile is a major Chinese carmaker with international operations, so leadership changes can affect its strategy and investor confidence. Li Shufu founded the group and built it into a global automotive player.
